claims.text: Tx incl IV hydration, warm compresses, sialogogues (eg, lemon drops), gland massage, oral hygiene, analgesics
claims.quote: Treatment includes IV hydration; antibiotics; stimulation of salivary flow by application of warm compresses; administration of sialagogues, such as lemon drops; salivary gland massage; oral hygiene; and appropriate analgesics.

claims.text: Sialogogues such as pilocarpine stim salivary flow
claims.quote: Supportive care may include warm compresses; nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs; sialogogues, such as pilocarpine to stimulate salivary flow; and sialendoscopy to clear ductal debris.
